He read the flow off the app and found three beats wrong/unclear: the snatch is overhead-to-overhead (not floor-to-overhead), the outside pendulum runs TWO full swings before the clean, and the clean is an INSIDE tactical clean, not a generic one. All three were already corrected in the flow bundle on 2026-07-09 — he was reading a stale cached copy (prod hadn't been redeployed, and the browser was caching the page + catalogue). The corrections were right; the app just never showed them to him.

exercises.notes: Ran it, but no bell weight or feel was reported — the session report was entirely about the flow being described wrong in the app. He correctly identified the three beats that the (stale) copy got wrong. Ask for the load/feel read next KB day.

lessonsForFutureWeeks: **He reads the flows off the app mid-session and trusts them — so a stale app is a training bug, not a cosmetic one.** He caught all three wrong beats himself (snatch overhead-to-overhead, two pendulum swings, inside tactical clean) because the bell told him otherwise. The fix on disk was already right; the app was serving a cached pre-fix copy. Both cache layers are now closed (no-cache on the page + catalogue), but the standing rule holds: after a data fix, DEPLOY — a corrected JSON that isn't deployed is a corrected JSON he never sees.
